eventDetail.scope: The 2nd International Conference on Quantum Computing Systems and Applications (QCSA 2027) provides an international forum for researchers, practitioners, industry professionals, and technology leaders to present and discuss recent advances, emerging challenges, and innovative applications in quantum computing. The conference aims to bring together experts from academia and industry to exchange ideas, share research findings, and explore new directions in the design, implementation, and practical use of quantum computing systems.
